scope: Art crop only. No frame, title, cost, rank, rules text, targeting UI or gameplay changes.

composition.style: Clean dark object silhouettes; nearly black edges; restrained fog outlines emanating from the object. See art-proposals-v2.json for locked master objects and view rules.
composition.palettePolicy: Main action supplies dark ground and subdued center tint; an explicit element may tint emitted contour fog. Additional conditions use shapes and keep lower brightness. Avoid four competing saturated colors.
composition.overflow: Keep all gameplay tags unchanged; show the three selected secondary cues and list omitted candidates in preview diagnostics.
composition.selection: Primary maneuver wins over generic skill type. A pure skill uses its first authored effect/status object. It still counts as action + effect (two identities). Explicit art selection can order eligible secondary cues; otherwise use authored effect order, then tag order. Deduplicate identical cue recipes, skip a cue already shown as the main object. Conflicting primary maneuvers are an authoring error.

assetContract.format: transparent PNG/WebP for all layers except opaque background
assetContract.note: All components are design specifications, not shipped game assets. Assign approved asset IDs through the existing art-pack workflow later.

composition.masterReusePolicy: Reuse one master per object family, including repeated instances in a composition. A sword, scimitar and scythe are different families; every appearance of each family uses its same master.

coverage.excluded: Equipment, creature identity, run/property grants, costs, scaling, lifecycle and internal metadata are outside this art vocabulary. Broad card metadata is explicitly nonvisual. Active profile membership must filter reference-only statuses.
coverage.proposalNote: Every selected combat tag has a binding; shared symbols are intentional. Ability symbols are provisional art choices. No balance, damage, status or gameplay aliases are added.
